purpose: Unchanged compiled old builder and workload, consumed with new shared Abstractions. Not a newly recompiled old-shaped source test.
producer: dotnet build LegacyBoundary.csproj -c Release, net10.0, AssemblyName LegacyNativePolicyBoundary, DebugType none. References frozen pre-policy Azure.Functions.Cli.Abstractions.dll and its Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions and System.CommandLine contracts. LegacyBoundary.cs.txt preserves the source. The normal test build does not rebuild this binary.
compatibility: Old compiled builder and workload on new host only. A new policy workload requires a host whose Abstractions includes the new types and builder method. This fixture does not claim new workload compatibility with old hosts.
